description: This file contains a shell script that tests the detection of push errors in a Git repository, including setup of repositories, fake receive-pack scripts, and various push failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success and runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail and verifies failure.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up a test commit with a specified message.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified contents.
